items.s: FFL OR SSL TOP OF FINISH OR STRUCTURE LEVEL
HEAD & SILL LEVELS ON PLANS REFER TO WHAT IS INDICATED ON SCHEDULES
- BEFORE COMMENCING WITH ANY WORK, VERIFY ANY DISCREPANCY RELATED TO WORK INVOLVED.
- FOR HEAD & SILL LEVELS ON PLANS, REFER TO SCHEDULES (MEASURED FROM F.F.L. OF GROUND FLOOR)
- ANY DECORATION USED SHALL BE NON - COMBUSTIBLE OR FLAME PROOFED AS SPECIFIED. ROOF COVERING SHALL BE FIRE RETARDANT CONSTRUCTION.
- DRAWINGS ARE NOT TO BE SCALED AT ANY TIME. ALL DIMENSIONS ARE TO BE CHECKED AND VERIFIED BY THE CONTRACTOR PRIOR TO THE COMMENCEMENT
- UNLESS OTHERWISE INDICATED, ALL DIMENSIONS ARE IN MILLIMETER.
- DRAWINGS ARE TO BE READ IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE RELEVANT ARCHITECTURAL, INTERIOR, CIVIL, STRUCTURAL,MECHANICAL AND ELECTRICAL
ENGINEERING SERVICES DRAWINGS , TOGETHER WITH THE SPECIFICATIONS.
- DO NOT PROCEED IN AREAS OF DISCREPANCY UNTIL THE DISCREPANCY IS RESOLVED.
- THESE GENERAL NOTES AND LEGEND DELINEATE NON DESCRIBED CONDITIONS AND SCOPE OF WORK. THE INDICATIONS AS SHOWN SHALL APPLY TO ALL
PLAN SHEETS HEREIN INCLUDED, UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED. THE PLAN SHEETS INCLUDED HEREINAFTER ARE DOCUMENTS  OF SERVICE DEVELOPED TO
DEFINE THE  EXTENT OF QUANTITIES AND PHYSICAL RELATIONSHIP TO FACILITATE THE ERECTION OF THE CONSTRUCTION.
- REFERENCE TO ANY DETAIL OR DRAWING IS FOR CONVENIENCE ONLY AND DOES NOT LIMIT THE APPLICATION OF SUCH REFERENCE DETAIL OR DRAWING.
- ALL OPENING DIMENSIONS INDICATED ON PLANS ARE STRUCTURAL OPENING UNLESS OTHERWISE INDICATED
- PRIOR TO INSTALLATION OF SUSPENDED CEILING, THE SHOP DRAWINGS SHALL HAVE BEEN APPROVED BY THE ARCHITECT,STRUCTURAL  ENGINEER,
- ALL RIGHT ANGULAR INTERSECTIONS SHOWN ARE 90° UNLESS OTHERWISE INDICATED.
- CONTRACTOR SHOULD COORDINATE ALL MECHANICAL, ELECTRICAL & OTHER SERVICES OUTLETS, INLETS, ROUTING & FIXATION WITH ARCHITECTURAL &
INTERIOR FINISHES PRIOR TO START ANY WORK RELATED TO MENTIONED SERVICES. SHOP DRAWINGS OF SERVICES SHOULD INDICATE RELATION TO
ARCHITECTURAL & INTERIOR FINISHES IF ANY EXIST, (i.e.DRAINS, CLEANOUTS SHOULD BE COORDINATED WITH FLOOR FINISHING DIMENSIONS, SHAPES &
LEVELS. ALSO HVAC OUTLETS & INLETS, LIGHTING,SPRINKLERS ... etc. SHOULD BE COORDINATED WITH WALL & CEILING FINISHES).
- ANY ARCHITECTURAL WORK OR FINISHES RELATED TO SPECIAL MANUFACTURER REQUIREMENTS FOR SPACING, ( FIXATION & APPLICATION ... etc.) AND
RELATED TO OTHER STRUCTURAL,CIVIL OR SERVICES, SHOULD BE COORDINATED WITH THESE WORKS AND SERVICES PRIOR TO START IN ANY RELATED
WORK. EXAMPLE: CURTAIN WALLS, GLAZING, ALUMINUM CLADDING,STONE CLADDING, G.R.C. SCREENS, CANOPIES ... etc., SHOULD BE COORDINATED WITH
STRUCTURAL, CIVIL & OTHER SERVICES AS PER MANUFACTURER REQUIREMENTS FOR FIXATION OR APPLICATION PRIOR TO START WORK.
- ALL SERVICES MECHANICAL, ELECTRICAL ... etc. VISIBLE AND NOT INDICATED AS ARCHITECTURAL OR INTERIOR FEATURES SHOULD BE HIDDEN. EXAMPLE:
MECHANICAL & ELECTRICAL SERVICES ABOVE CEILINGS SHOULD NOT BE VISIBLE FROM UNDER THE CEILINGS. SERVICES IN MECHANICAL & ELECTRICAL
ROOMS, TERRACES & ROOFS SHOULD NOT BE VISIBLE FROM OUTSIDE OR THE CEILINGS. SERVICES IN MECHANICAL & ELECTRICAL ROOMS, TERRACES & ROOFS
SHOULD NOT BE VISIBLE FROM OUTSIDE OR ANY OCCUPIED OR PUBLIC SPACES.
- IN GLAZING, CURTAIN WALLS, GLASS WINDOWS & DOORS, ALL MANUFACTURER INSTRUCTIONS & RECOMMENDATIONS SHOULD BE CONSIDERED TO AVOID
ANY DEFORMATION OR DEFLECTION IN RELATED PANELS & COMPONENTS. ALSO ANY DEFORMED OR DISFIGURED IMAGE REFLECTIONS IN GLASS SHOULD BE
AVOIDED DUE TO ANY DEFECT IN MATERIALS OR IN WAY OF FIXATION.
- LIGHT FIXTURES WHICH ARE RELATED TO ARCHITECTURAL & INTERIOR FINISHES SHOULD BE COORDINATED IN LOCATION,METHOD OF FIXATION &
MANUFACTURER REQUIREMENTS FOR VENTILATION, ACCESS OF MAINTENANCE & TRANSFORMERS PRIOR TO START ANY RELATED WORKS.
- ALL FIXATION DETAILS RELATED TO FINISHES, METAL WORKS, WOOD WORKS, STONE WORK, G.R.C., CEILINGS ... etc. AND NOT INDICATED AS
NOTES AS REQUIRED TO LIMIT AIR LEAKAGE:
A. ALL EXTERNAL DOORS SHALL LIMIT AIR LEAKAGE AROUND THEIR PERIMETER WHEN IN A CLOSED POSITION:
1- BY PROVIDING SEAL OR ASTRAL AT THE SILL AND JAMBS.
2- MEETING PORTIONS OF SECTIONAL BI-PARTING OR DOUBLE DOORS SHALL BE PROVIDED WITH A WEATHER TIGHT ASTRAL OR SEAL.
B. OPEN EXTERIOR JOINTS AROUND WINDOW AND DOOR FRAMES BETWEEN WALLS AND ROOF, AT PENETRATIONS OF UTILITIES THROUGH THE ENVELOPE,
SHALL BE SEALED, CAULKED OR WEATHER STRIPED TO LIMIT AIR LEAKAGE.
- ALL ACCESS DOORS, SIZE AND LOCATION IN FALSE CEILING AND SHAFTS ARE SUBJECT TO SERVICE REQUIREMENT ON SITE.
- ALL DIFFUSERS FIXING AND FITTINGS SHALL BE HIDDEN
- ALL SHOP DRAWINGS SHOWING CLADDING ELEVATIONS, REFLECTED CEILINGS OR FLOOR TILING SHOULD SHOW OR INCLUDE ALLTYPES OF EXPOSED ITEMS
OR FIXTURES TO BE FIXED ON THEM SUCH AS FLOOR DRAINS, CLEANOUTS, LIGHTING FIXTURES,MECHANICAL OPENINGS AND GRILLS; ACCESS PANELS AND
DOORS, SIGNAGE PANELS, LIGHT POLES, MANHOLE COVERS, DRAINS,FIRE HOSE AND EXTINGUISHER CABINET, FIRE ALARM EQUIPMENT ...... etc. THE SAME ARE
TO BE SUBMITTED FOR THE APPROVAL OF SITE ENGINEER.
